row.team_price_text: Basic: $13.75/mo flat for 1 project, unlimited users (annual)
row.evidence: Zeplin's pricing page lists 'Single sign-on, MFA, and SCIM' only under Enterprise (Contact us), and the SCIM help article says it is only available to teams on the Enterprise Plan.
row.notes: Plan lineup changed since June: the Team ($6/editor) and Organization ($12/editor, 12-seat minimum) plans are gone. The pricing page now shows Free, Basic (flat per-project price with unlimited users, from $13.75/mo for 1 project annual), Advanced ($12/seat/mo annual, $15 monthly) and Enterprise (Contact sales). Basic is the cheapest multi-user paid tier but is flat-priced, so per-user and multiplier fields are null. SSO and SCIM remain Enterprise-only. SCIM supports /Users only (no groups); IdP guides use custom/non-gallery apps for Okta, Entra, OneLogin and JumpCloud; Google is SAML only.

plans.name: Basic
plans.price_text: $13.75/mo for 1 project (annual; packs of 1, 3, 6, 9 or 12 projects), unlimited users

plans.name: Advanced
plans.price_text: $12 per seat per month, paid annually

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > User Provisioning > Create SCIM token (shown once)

operations.notes: Zeplin lists Create Users, Update User Attributes and Deactivate Users as the IdP actions to enable; PUT vs PATCH is not documented, so update_put/update_patch stay null.

deprovision.data_retained: The Zeplin account survives (personal and other team workspaces); content the member created stays in the workspace.
deprovision.notes: For manual removal Zeplin says the paid seat can be reused without being billed again, but subscribed seats are not reduced; the SCIM article does not say the same for SCIM removals.

roles.how: A single default role and default access settings, set in Zeplin, apply to every user added by SCIM; no per-user role attribute is documented.

limitations.text: Only the /Users endpoint is supported; group processing is ignored or can make the IdP fail to enable SCIM (Entra must have group mapping disabled).
Each workspace needs its own SCIM token and its own IdP app.

scim.notes: No attribute list, filtering, pagination, token expiry or rate limits are documented.

capabilities.notes: delete_user here means removing a member from the organization (workspace), not deleting the Zeplin account.

endpoints.purpose: Invite an organization member (admin personal access token only)
Update a member's role, access restriction and tags
Remove a member from the organization
Invite a member to a project
Remove a member from a project

limitations.text: Invite, update and remove organization members only work with an organization admin's personal access token; OAuth apps are not allowed.

user_api.notes: The pricing page lists the Zeplin API and webhooks on every plan, including Free; organization-member endpoints act on team workspaces (Advanced and Enterprise). Activity logs (Enterprise) are emailed as a CSV download; no audit-log API is documented. No rate limits are published in the reference.

okta.notes: Zeplin's Okta guide builds a custom SAML 2.0 app integration and enables SCIM on it; no OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/zeplin/ returned 404).

entra.notes: Zeplin's guide uses a non-gallery application with SCIM provisioning.

google.notes: Zeplin documents Google Workspace as a custom SAML 2.0 app; no SCIM for Google.

onelogin.notes: Zeplin's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Enterprise)' app.

jumpcloud.notes: Zeplin's guide uses a JumpCloud Custom SAML App with SCIM on the Identity Management tab.
